protection_intro.title: Check local protection
protection_intro.instructions: Your profile and PIN are saved. Start the check to lock the operating system screen. Unlock it normally, then enter your saved Tokenlogue PIN. The check does not send messages.
protection_intro.manual_notice: Automatic screen locking is not confirmed yet. If you continue, lock Tokenlogue manually. You can repeat the check from the menu.
protection_intro.preferences_failed: The setup step could not be saved. Try again. Your profile and PIN have not been reset.
